applicabilityBasis.summary: USDV is an overcollateralized on-chain CDP stablecoin minted against crypto and stablecoin collateral (USDC, USDT0, kHYPE, WHYPE) on HyperEVM with no legal issuer obligated to redeem holders for fixed fiat monetary value under GENIUS Act Section 2(22). Redemptions return underlying on-chain collateral assets rather than bank-wired US dollars.

references.label: Delpho redemptions and the peg documentation

genius.notes: Delpho operates as an overcollateralized CDP protocol on HyperEVM without a licensed fiat issuer or fixed-money fiat redemption obligation. Delpho publishes on-chain contract addresses, collateral parameters, and restricted-jurisdiction disclosures for its web interface, and relies on smart-contract redemptions into collateral rather than regulated bank reserves or monthly CPA attestations.

references.label: Delpho regulatory and venue risk documentation

sourcesChecked: Public Law 119-27, Section 2(22) payment stablecoin definition
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-11-27, Delpho's primary documentation and verified HyperEVM contracts establish an overcollateralized on-chain CDP and PSM protocol returning crypto/stablecoin collateral rather than a legal fiat redemption obligation; no GENIUS PPSI authorization or public enforcement action applies or was found.
